# `gcp.authzextension`

AuthzExtension is a resource that allows traffic forwarding to a callout backend service to make an authorization decision.

[networkservices](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | networkservices |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `networkservices.googleapis.com/AuthzExtension` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authzExtensions?authzExtensionId={{name}}` |
| Read | yes | `GET projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authzExtensions/{{name}}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authzExtensions/{{name}}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/authzExtensions/{{name}}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |
